meaning:
ἀνα-βάλλω
[in LXX: Psa.78:21 89:38 (עָבַר), 1Ki.28:14, Psa.104:2 (עָטָה) ;]
to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., Act.24:22.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”
